text: My name is Viktor Benitez and I'm a fisherman. I live at 3408 Bellisima Place, and my email address is viktor-benitez@yahoo.net. The squid immediately recoiled from the light, and I was able to break free of its tentacles. I swam back to my boat as fast as I could, and I didn't look back. I'm not sure what would have happened to me if I hadn't remembered that giant squids are attracted to light. I'm just glad that I was able to get away, and I'm even more glad that I can share my story with others.
